name: Zippel Bay State Park, Anglers Campground
waterfront_evidence: DNR park map spk00284.pdf (2024): Angler's loop in the woods beside the ranger-station-to-marina road, ~1.4 km S of Zippel Bay; ReserveMN facility 888 search/details for all 16 sites (read 2026-11-11): no 'Water Front' amenity, 'Lake/River/Creek: 1.5 miles'. Esri World_Imagery 2026-11-11 at 48.8547,-94.8595 (500 m frame) with every unit's ReserveMN map point plotted: sites 42-57 under continuous forest canopy, no water anywhere in the frame -> not waterfront.
inclusion_evidence: MN DNR Zippel Bay record spk00284 + park map spk00284.pdf (read 2026-11-11): 'There are 57 drive-in sites. There are no electric sites.'; RV length limit 50 ft; the map's Angler's inset shows sites 42-57 on their own loop road with a hand pump and two toilets, off the park road ~1.6 km W of Ridge. ReserveMN PlaceId 135, facility 888: 16 web-bookable 'Standard Back In' drive-in sites at $24, pads 30-60 ft (none under 30), 2027 season 04-16..11-03. The DNR's advice against large RVs applies past Ridge Campground, on the other road. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits.
note: Zippel Bay State Park's western campground, a wooded loop off the road from the ranger station to the marina; the park's other three campgrounds, nearer the beach, have their own entry. Showers and the dump station are by the ranger station, about 1.3 km away. --Claude

sites.note: All back-in; ReserveMN pads run 30-60 ft, the longest in the park.

fees.note: ReserveMN: $24 a night for each of the 16 sites, 2027 nights. Read 2026-11-11.
